Find Your Place at Exodigo.

Join a team of builders, innovators, and problem-solvers tackling one of the world's biggest infrastructure challenges. You'll work alongside experts in engineering, software, AI, hardware, and geophysics to turn massive amounts of data into insights that drive critical decisions.

Innovation starts here

Great ideas can come from anywhere.

The world is investing trillions in infrastructure—the transit, energy, and water systems that generations will depend on every day. Yet too much of that investment is put at risk by what no one can see underground.

Protecting and transforming infrastructure takes more than cutting-edge technology. It takes people who are curious, collaborative, and eager to push boundaries. We foster a culture where initiative is encouraged, ideas are challenged, and innovation thrives across disciplines.

The work is ambitious, the pace is fast, and the opportunity to make an impact is real. Join a team united by a shared mission to transform the future of infrastructure.

Invested in you

Benefits that support the whole you.

  • Health & Wellness

    Your well-being matters. We offer comprehensive healthcare benefits designed to support you and your family at every stage.

    Medical, dental, and vision coverage (employer-paid & premium) • FSA • Life, disability, and AD&D insurance • Mental health resources

  • Time Off

    We believe great work starts with real balance. Our flexible time off programs help you rest, recharge, and be there for life's important moments.

    Generous paid time off for vacation & sick days • Company holidays • Paid parental leave

  • Work From Anywhere

    Work where you do your best work. We provide the flexibility and support you need to thrive, wherever you're based.

    Remote-first flexibility across the U.S. • Home office support & equipment reimbursement • Coworking space access

  • Financial Wellbeing

    We're invested in your future and committed to rewarding your contributions.

    Competitive compensation • Equity from day one • 401(k) matching program

  • Learning & Development

    We're committed to helping our employees grow and succeed by investing in their development at every stage of their careers.

    Professional training & workshops • Mentorship & coaching • Continuous feedback & career development• Internal mobility

  • Perks

    Beyond professional growth, we foster meaningful connections and create opportunities for employees to engage, celebrate, and thrive.

    In-person & virtual team events • Company swag • Recognition of personal and professional milestones

*The benefits described on this page are provided in accordance with the company's internal policies and procedures. All benefits are subject to change and are contingent upon the terms outlined in the individual employment agreement signed between the company and each employee.
